name: Ribbon Seraph
description: A floating printer-ribbon seraph shaped like a sculpted manta: folded black satin wings, oil-slick ink edges, long curling silk streamers, and a hollow machined-metal spool halo. Separate rigid wing and streamer pivots; physically lit woven PBR surfaces throughout.
surface_pipeline: Original generated <=512px tileable PBR image maps packed into blend and embedded in GLB. Closed cloth meshes with physical thickness, satin normals, metallic rounded rims and wound spool geometry. No unlit/cel shader.
cosmetic_fx: Toggleable suspended ink droplets and two broken oil-slick liquid orbit arcs. Cosmetic geometry is isolated below FX_ROOT; clean GLB is effect-free.
recolor_contract: Semantic materials expose linear baseColorFactor over grayscale maps for full runtime recolor; any authored multicolor exceptions are noted per palette slot. Blender uses equivalent texture multiplied by semantic_tint.
runtime: Rigid node posing only; optional FX are static toggleable visual meshes, not scripted abilities. No skinning/animations.
coordinate_system: glTF: metres, +Y up, -Z forward; source Blender +Z up, +Y forward; right +X.
provenance_detail: Original Blender meshes and original generated PBR image maps, created for this request by dot with Astra 6 max collaborators. No downloaded models, scanned assets or external textures.
reexport_note: All actual LOD meshes are baked and editable, and static same-parent islands are batched. export_editable.py re-exports LOD0 clean/FX; finish_ribbon_seraph.py can refresh both LODs without original meshes. Render refreshed after optimization.

optimization.strategy: Closed ribbon grids resampled with thickness, rim boundaries, original UVs and sampled authored normals; spool wraps use fewer circular cross-sections; part-specific baked decimation for hardware and optional FX. Original PBR maps and all 17 rigid controls retained.
optimization.lod_selection: Caller chooses model.glb near camera or model_lod1.glb at distance. Suggested initial transition: bounding-box screen height below 300 pixels, then tune for target device; no automatic LOD runtime is included.
optimization.static_batching: Join disconnected geometry only when rigid parent and material set match. All 17 movable controls retained; no independent articulation joined.
optimization.uv_repair: Degenerate inherited rim/hardware UV triangles received planar fallback UVs. Main ribbon face UVs and PBR maps unchanged.
